greeting: Stand in the light; you need hide nothing here.
prayer: I hear the question beneath your words.
Carry this warmth to someone who needs it.
offering: A gift freely given shines brightest.
Your offering feeds more than flame.
I accept. Let generosity follow you beyond this shrine.
failure: One eclipse does not end the sun. Rise and try again.
return: Even after absence, a new dawn is possible. I remember you.
recognition: This shrine remembers the light you chose to become.
